name: TeamStarWolf - Lylat Mission Coverage
description: Curated practitioner view, not an official MITRE mapping. Enterprise ATT&CK technique coverage across the 28 enterprise Lylat Labs training missions: score normalizes each technique's mission count to the most-mapped technique (14); 100 does not mean full coverage. Planned/training coverage only — the missions are execution_verified:false, so this is NOT a detection or validated-coverage result. ICS/OT, Mobile, and ATLAS mission coverage is vendored separately (they need their own matrices). No coverage guarantee. Provenance spans ATT&CK 16.1 -> 19.2 as bundled.
